prompt: Pink bakes a giant birthday cake
title: Giant Birthday Cake
irony: Pink says yes to every extra until the giant cake can only be shared after she finally says no.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Sun fills Auntie Blue's big kitchen where Pink dusts flour over a giant empty bowl.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green counts candles for Navy's birthday while Pink says yes to every topping request.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Lilac sweeps in with extra cherries and dares Pink to make the cake taller than Navy.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The kids chant for birthday cake as Pink piles the layers higher in the big kitchen.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Green corrects the recipe while Jade tosses in handfuls and batter slops over the rim.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The wobbling cake towers past the doorway and Pink laughs Of course, darling, one more cherry.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The kids chant for birthday cake as the giant tower sways above the birthday table.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Pink holds the shaking pan and owns how each yes left less room to share it.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Pink pats Green's hand, says no to one more layer, and cuts doors in the frosting.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Pink serves the swaying tower slice by slice until every neighbour holds a plate.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Crumbs cover the big table as Navy shares his giant wish with the whole street.
